name: Supabase URL is real value
description: Check .env* files for NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL — must exist and not be a placeholder (e.g. your-project-url-here)

name: Supabase anon key is real value
description: Check .env* files for NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY — must exist and not be a placeholder

name: Protected routes configured
description: Verify protectedPaths array exists in src/proxy.ts and contains route entries

name: DATABASE_URL points to real Postgres
description: Check DATABASE_URL is set and does not contain 'pglite' or 'localhost' placeholder patterns

name: Migration files exist
description: Check that at least one SQL migration file exists

name: App builds successfully
description: Run pnpm build and check exit code (0 = PASS)

name: Deployment configured
description: Check for vercel.json or Vercel framework detection (Next.js auto-detected)

name: No API keys in client code
description: Scan src/ for server-only env vars that should never appear in client code

name: Sentry DSN configured
description: Check for SENTRY_DSN in env or Sentry config files with DSN value

name: Default locale and middleware configured
description: Verify next-intl config exists with default locale and middleware/proxy entrypoint is present

name: README is not template defaults
description: Check if README.md has been customized (differs from template default title/description)

name: Site URL configured
description: Check NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL is set in env (required for sitemap, hreflang, OG)

name: Sitemap configured
description: Verify sitemap.ts exists and contains publicRoutes array

name: Robots.txt configured
description: Verify robots.ts exists with rules configuration

name: OG images and meta tags present
description: Check for default OG image and metadata generation in pages

name: Resend API key configured
description: Check RESEND_API_KEY exists in .env* files

name: From address customized
description: Check EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS is set and not the default noreply@example.com

name: Email templates exist
description: Check at least one email template file exists

name: Privacy policy page exists
description: Scan for a privacy policy page in the app directory

name: Terms of service page exists
description: Scan for a terms of service page in the app directory

name: Bundle size acceptable
description: Check .next build output for oversized chunks (warn if any chunk > 500KB)

name: Viewport meta tag present
description: Check root layout has viewport meta configuration

name: Onboarding flow exists
description: Verify onboarding page/flow exists and is reachable

name: Hreflang tags for all locales
description: Check that hreflang alternate links are configured for all locales

name: Sender domain not default
description: Check EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS uses a custom domain (not resend.dev or example.com)

name: All locale files exist
description: Check locale directories exist for all configured locales (en, hi, bn)

name: No missing translation keys
description: Compare JSON keys across all locale files — flag any keys present in default but missing in others

name: Image alt tags present
description: Scan JSX/TSX for img/Image tags and check for alt prop presence

name: Pipeline config exists
description: Check for GitHub Actions workflow files

name: Test files exist
description: Check for Playwright test files in tests/ directory

name: Playwright config present
description: Check for Playwright configuration file

name: Images use next/image
description: Check that components import and use next/image for optimization

name: Help or FAQ page exists
description: Scan for help or FAQ page in app directory

name: CSP headers configured
description: Check for CSP header configuration in middleware or next.config

name: Tracking configured
description: Scan for analytics integration (any common provider)

name: main branch protected on GitHub
description: Run gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/main/protection. PASS if it returns a protection object (has required_status_checks or required_pull_request_reviews). FAIL if it returns 404 (main is unprotected — direct pushes possible). WARN if gh is not installed or not authenticated.

name: CI passing on main
description: Check the latest CI outcome on main. Prefer: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/main/check-runs --jq '[.check_runs[].conclusion]' — PASS if every conclusion is success/skipped/neutral, FAIL if any is failure/cancelled/timed_out. Fallback: gh run list --branch main --limit 20. WARN if gh unavailable or no runs exist yet.

name: Auto-delete branch on merge enabled
description: Run gh api repos/{owner}/{repo} --jq .delete_branch_on_merge. PASS if true, FAIL if false. WARN if gh unavailable.

name: Squash-only merge configured
description: Run gh api repos/{owner}/{repo} --jq '{s:.allow_squash_merge,m:.allow_merge_commit,r:.allow_rebase_merge}'. PASS if allow_squash_merge=true AND allow_merge_commit=false AND allow_rebase_merge=false. Otherwise FAIL (merge/rebase-merge muddy the linear history semantic-release reads). WARN if gh unavailable.

name: Required CI secrets present
description: Derive required secret names from .github/workflows/*.yml ${{ secrets.* }} references, excluding GITHUB_TOKEN and secrets for removed features. Run gh secret list. PASS if every required secret is present, FAIL listing any missing. WARN if gh unavailable.

name: RUN_PROD_MIGRATIONS enabled in production
description: Verify RUN_PROD_MIGRATIONS=true exists in the PRODUCTION environment. Use the Vercel MCP if available, else run vercel env ls production. Without it, prod builds SKIP migrations (see .claude/rules/database.md). PASS if set to true, FAIL if missing or false, WARN if Vercel is not linked/available.

name: Production env parity with local secrets
description: For each server-side secret configured locally (DATABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, plus RESEND_API_KEY / DIFY_* / SENTRY_* if those features are in use), confirm the same key exists in the Vercel PRODUCTION environment. PASS if all present, FAIL listing any missing, WARN if Vercel not linked/available. Never print secret VALUES.

name: Supabase security advisors clean
description: Use the Supabase MCP get_advisors(type=security) for the linked project. PASS if there are no ERROR-level advisories (e.g. RLS disabled on a public table, security-definer/exposed views). FAIL listing any ERROR-level findings. WARN if the Supabase MCP is not connected.
